label: Sample bonded challenge — either party disputes a pending finding
role: Provider (wallet A) or Customer (wallet B), inside the frozen challenge window
preconditions: Incident status is PENDING (adjudication produced a decisive finding)
No challenge exists yet for this incident

form_fields.challenge_statement: The adjudication attributed the observation to the wrong service incident: the dependency failure ended before the measured window began, so the frozen clause cannot causally cover it.

call_arguments.challenge_text: The adjudication attributed the observation to the wrong service incident: the dependency failure ended before the measured window began, so the frozen clause cannot causally cover it.

expected_result: Challenge OPEN with the stake escrowed. Resolution re-fetches every original source plus this one: UPHELD revises the finding and returns the stake to the challenger; REJECTED awards it to the counterparty; INCONCLUSIVE leaves the pending finding intact.
alternative_path: Without a challenge, finalizing after the challenge deadline settles: customer payout = max credit x liability share (capped by the bond), remainder returns to the provider, both as withdrawable credits.
